name: record-outreach
description: Record outreach for a task that no send tool made. Call it after you submit a web form, make a call, or contact an organization outside email for a task, so their reply can find the task. Sends are recorded automatically.

inputs.website: string? (the organization's own website or domain)
inputs.form_url: string? (the form's address, if not on the website)
inputs.contact_given: string? (the contact detail you left, e.g. "the principal's email")
